name: Gemma 4 LiteRT Wiki
description:
Gemma 4 runs inside Obsidian itself via LiteRT-LM and WebGPU — free, private, offline AI for your notes. No Ollama, no API key, no subscription, no server; your notes never leave your device.

Follows Andrej Karpathy’s LLM-wiki pattern: your notes are never modified, while Ingest and Scan turn them into a living Wiki of cross-note connections, concept pages, tags and links.

Chat with one note, several, or the whole Wiki — keep any answer worth keeping. Includes Quiz, Flashcards, Find Gaps, and custom Skills.

Pure Markdown, no database lock-in.
author: itsyuimorii
